killer.name: Killer
killer.goal: Kill until the Cabal matches the village (one villager left at {byCount.villageAtMostOne.sizes}), and never get voted out.
killer.win: Parity at {byCount.parity.from}+ players, living Village at most 1 at {byCount.villageAtMostOne.sizes}, or the Final Night vote fails.
killer.cardText: Walk in a borrowed character. Strike after dark when the room is empty, clean one clue, wash at the well, then be the loudest voice asking who did it.
killer.beware: Clues match your own traits whatever face you wear; your height never changes; Blood shows within {clues.clues.blood.params.visibleTiles} tiles; a guarded target voids your kill.

accomplice.name: Accomplice
accomplice.goal: Cover for the Killer and take the knife if they fall.
accomplice.cardText: You never hold the knife, only the alibi. Forge trails, break the right doors, vouch at the right moment.
accomplice.beware: Inspect marks plants Forged; a Forged entry tells the village an Accomplice exists; your cover is a claim someone may test.

heir.name: Accomplice, Knife-bearer
heir.goal: Carry on the Killer's work alone: strike after dark, keep your cover.
heir.cardText: The Knife has passed to you. The Killer is gone and the village does not know it yet; finish what they started.
heir.beware: Your Hunger clock starts in the round you inherit; your cover is still a claim someone may test.

detective.name: Detective

townWork.nfy: Inspects and compares clues: clues verify only at the Constables' pace

detective.goal: Verify the clues that narrow the suspects.
detective.cardText: Collect, inspect, cross-reference. Your Verified clues narrow the board; the village does the rest.
detective.beware: Prime target; the Rag erases clues; forgeries cost Lenses; Compare never gives a name. If you die the Magnifier drops and anyone can Inspect in {abilities.abilities.inspect.params.droppedMagnifierCastS} s.

doctor.name: Doctor

townWork.nfy: Bandages, Salts and autopsies: no healing at the surgery while gone

doctor.goal: Keep people alive and read the dead.
doctor.cardText: Keep people alive and read the dead. Your autopsy says when; that is what breaks alibis.

butler.name: Butler

townWork.nfy: Keys and the manor ledger: no ledger slips

butler.goal: Control the doors and say who went where.
butler.cardText: You know every door in HollowMere. Control the wings, read the ledger, say who went where.
butler.beware: Universal access makes you the obvious suspect; Skeleton Key use looks like yours.

child.name: Child

townWork.nfy: Witnesses and errands: fewer witness lines, errands go undone

child.goal: Hide, watch, and remember who you saw.
child.cardText: You are small and quiet. Hide, watch, remember.
child.beware: Top kill target; vision {balance.vision.childDeltaTiles} tile; cannot pick up items.

townsfolk.name: Townsfolk

townWork.nfy: Tasks and chores: the chores it carried go undone

townsfolk.goal: Do your chores in pairs and vote with evidence.
townsfolk.cardText: Do your chores with others to build alibis, mark what you see, vote with evidence.

drifter.name: Drifter
drifter.win: Get ejected (solo win; the match continues and the end screen lists you among the winners).
drifter.cardText: You want to hang. Be suspicious enough to be voted out, not so obvious they ignore you.
drifter.beware: A calm village; dying to the Killer is a loss; counts as nobody for parity; you wear a cover like the Cabal, but alone.

ranger.name: Ranger

townWork.nfy: Patrols and snares: the trails go unwatched, snares are not reset

ranger.goal: Hunt the wolves and make your {word:abilities.abilities.arrest.usesPerMatch} arrest count.
ranger.cardText: You hunt wolves. {Word:abilities.abilities.arrest.usesPerMatch} arrest per match: be right.

thief.name: Thief
thief.goal: Escape by the sea door at the back of the cave holding 3 Heirlooms.
thief.win: Escape by the sea door at the back of the cave holding 3 Heirlooms.
thief.beware: Thefts look like Killer activity; counts as Village for parity.

townWork.nfy: Séances: no word from the dead

vicar.name: Vicar
vicar.goal: Learn {word:balance.nightPowers.perNight} soul's faction each night and steer the vote.
vicar.cardText: Everyone in HollowMere confesses to you sooner or later. Each night, learn where {word:balance.nightPowers.perNight} soul stands, then choose how much to say.
vicar.beware: Everyone can see you are the Vicar, the Cabal first among them; if your card was not dealt, a Cabal player may wear your face and lie in your name.

watchman.name: Watchman

townWork.nfy: Keeps a door each night: that door goes unwatched, the curfew is looser

watchman.goal: Stand guard over {word:balance.nightPowers.perNight} neighbour each night.
watchman.cardText: You walk the lanes after dark. Each night, choose {word:balance.nightPowers.perNight} door to stand by; if a blade comes for that soul tonight, it fails.
watchman.beware: You cannot watch yourself or the same soul two nights running; poison and the Gamekeeper's shot go past you.

herbalist.name: Herbalist
herbalist.goal: Save one life and end one, {times:roles.roles.herbalist.startKit.0.qty} each, and be right both times.
herbalist.cardText: {Word:roles.roles.herbalist.startKit.0.qty} bottle saves, {word:roles.roles.herbalist.startKit.1.qty} bottle ends. Pour the first where the knife will fall and the second only where you are certain.
herbalist.beware: Nightshade kills a villager as readily as a killer, and a Remedy cannot stop it.

gamekeeper.name: Gamekeeper

townWork.nfy: Keeps the woods: wolves press closer at the wood's edge while gone

gamekeeper.goal: If you fall, take the right one with you.
gamekeeper.cardText: Vane paid you to keep the wood. If they come for you, you will not go alone; make sure the one you take is the one who came.
gamekeeper.beware: You never see the blow that fells you, and the face that walked up may have been borrowed; a wasted shot kills a friend.

lamplighter.name: Lamplighter

townWork.nfy: Lights the lantern posts at dusk: posts stay dark, creatures come nearer, Fear rises

lamplighter.goal: Do your chores in pairs and vote with evidence.
lamplighter.cardText: You light the lanterns that keep the wolves off the square. Work beside others, mark what you see, vote with evidence.

baker.name: Baker
baker.goal: Do your chores in pairs and vote with evidence.
baker.cardText: Up before anyone, flour to the elbows. Do your chores in company, mark what you see, vote with evidence.

fisher.name: Fisher

townWork.nfy: Fish to the market: the fish stock and the Game Pie's parts run short

fisher.goal: Do your chores in pairs and vote with evidence.
fisher.cardText: The fog keeps the boats in. Mend the nets beside a neighbour, mark what you see, vote with evidence.

tinner.name: Tinner

townWork.nfy: Tin ore to the forge: the tier-2 tools and armour stop

tinner.goal: Do your chores in pairs and vote with evidence.
tinner.cardText: The mine is shut; your hands are not. Work in pairs, mark what you see, vote with evidence.
